  • Serviceability Settlement (Phase_1): 14 staggered soil nails reduced embankment crest settlement from 52.60 mm to 14.03 mm (73.33% reduction), well within IRC/MoRTH permissible limits (<25 mm). 🖼️ +Ref Photo 🗑️ Delete
